preamble: Wordplay in 38 clues omits one (or once, two) of three related theme words.

clue.text: Central American coming from northern Guiana

parts.note: N is the map abbreviation for north or northern

indicators.note: what comes from raw material is made out of it, so the letters are reworked into something new

parts.note: the country name, taken letter for letter as raw material
nothing in the clue: one of the three vehicles the preamble says are left out of the wordplay

explanation.surface: Someone from Central America whose family came from the north of Guiana.
explanation.walkthrough: The preamble's three theme words are vehicles. Guiana sounds like the true homeland, but it is raw material only, and one vehicle must be added to the rearranged letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Nicaragua lies in Central America, so a native or citizen of that country is a Central American.

clue.text: Crazed commander's island

parts.note: crazed and mad are synonyms
an aga is a commander or chief officer in the old Ottoman Empire
the possessive ending, taken as written
nothing in the clue: one of the three vehicles the preamble says are left out of the wordplay

explanation.surface: A deranged military leader who owns his own island.
explanation.walkthrough: AGA is a crossword regular for a Turkish officer. The wordplay stops at MADAGAS; the omitted theme vehicle CAR completes it.
explanation.definitionFit: Madagascar is the large island nation off the south-east coast of Africa in the Indian Ocean.

clue.text: Frost oddly seen in village near Salisbury

explanation.surface: A man called Frost spotted, oddly enough, in a Wiltshire village.
explanation.walkthrough: Frost is a surname here, not weather. Salisbury is a cathedral city in Wiltshire, in southern England, and the village is small enough that crossings help.
explanation.definitionFit: Fovant is a small Wiltshire village a few miles west of Salisbury, known for the regimental badges cut into its chalk downs.

clue.text: Wielded gun, swallowing drug, having no ambition

explanation.walkthrough: The drug goes inside the shuffled gun, between UN and G. This is one of the clues that has no theme word missing.
explanation.definitionFit: To aspire is to have ambitions, so someone unaspiring lacks any ambition or drive to get on.
